original:
If the roots are centered at their common mean and $S_{m}$ denotes their
sum of squares, coefficient comparison gives

 $S_{m-1}=\frac{m-2}{m}S_{m},\qquad\frac{S_{m}}{m(m-1)}=\frac{S_{2}}{2}.$ 

(7)
